notes.title: Prepare yourself...
notes.content:
[h1]The long wait is over[/h1]

We started this journey with the dream to publish a game, but not just any game, we wanted to make something different. There were many bumps along the way, and we had to set development aside for a while, but the dream was never forgotten. The flame of REalM kept burning inside of us, waiting to be unleashed, and the time has finally come. To all those who have been waiting all this time, we're sorry it took so long and we thank you infinitely for your patience. To everyone, we hope you can enjoy our game as much as we've enjoyed working on it. Don't be afraid and dive into REalM on October 30!
